description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-10-05)

### ✨ Initial Release of Anghami Plus Patches

* Rebranded suite under Kero309x for Anghami 8.0.28
* Block audio ads between songs
* Block promotional popup offers & marketing dialogs
* Hide upgrade banners, subscription upsell cards, and Gold sections
* Disable forced shuffle mode & unlock on-demand song selection
* Unlock client-side Plus features & offline UI mode
* Unlimited track skips and queue navigation
* Expand local download limits & disable quota restrictions
* Show official Plus badge on Profile and Account settings
* Disable third-party trackers, Silo analytics, and Bugsnag crash logs
* Emulate official application signature headers
